recognize_zh: 低倍 CD10 染色中，上方一個明顯擴大的結節裡，CD10 陽性的生發中心 B 細胞被打散成許多不規則的小團塊，彼此之間夾著大量 CD10 陰性的小淋巴球（外套區細胞侵入）；下方則有一個較小、較完整的生發中心可比較，這就是生發中心漸進性轉化（PTGC）的典型碎裂樣式。
features: Markedly enlarged nodule several times the size of a normal follicle (upper field)
CD10-positive germinal center cells broken up into multiple irregular, fragmented clusters within the nodule
Large numbers of CD10-negative small lymphocytes (mantle zone cells) permeating and separating the germinal center fragments
Smaller, more compact CD10-positive germinal center in the lower field for comparison
Scattered single CD10-positive cells in interfollicular areas; no CD10 staining outside follicular structures in sheets
describe_en: Low-power CD10 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows a markedly enlarged nodule in which CD10-positive germinal center B cells are fragmented into multiple irregular clusters that are separated and infiltrated by numerous CD10-negative small lymphocytes, representing mantle zone cell ingrowth. A smaller, more intact CD10-positive germinal center is present nearby for comparison. No CD10-positive cells are seen in interfollicular sheets. The findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules also contain small B cells but harbor scattered large LP cells (CD20+, OCT2/BOB1 strong, EMA+) ringed by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC has no LP cells and retains CD10+ germinal center remnants.
FL shows back-to-back uniform follicles with CD10+ cells that are BCL2-positive and may extend into interfollicular areas, unlike the fragmented BCL2-negative germinal center remnants in PTGC.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Follicular colonization shows CD10-negative, BCL2-positive marginal zone cells replacing germinal centers with light-chain restriction, whereas PTGC is polytypic.
MCL may surround residual 'naked' germinal centers, but the expanded cells are CD5+, cyclin D1+ and SOX11+.
